question:
What is the mean of the following distribution? 

 
 

 **Marks**
 19
 36
 <td style="text-align: cent
solution:
**Given:**

Marks = [19, 36, 60, 69, 85]

No. of Students = [63, 62, 59, 17, 70]

**Formula Used:**

Mean = (Σ(fᵢ × xᵢ)) / Σ(fᵢ)

Where:

fᵢ = Frequency (No. of Students)

xᵢ = Marks

**Calculation:**

fᵢ × xᵢ:

19 × 63 = 1197

36 × 62 = 2232

60 × 59 = 3540

69 × 17 = 1173

85 × 70 = 5950

Σ(fᵢ × xᵢ) = 1197 + 2232 + 3540 + 1173 + 5950 = 14092

Σ(fᵢ) = 63 + 62 + 59 + 17 + 70 = 271

Mean:

⇒ Mean = Σ(fᵢ × xᵢ) / Σ(fᵢ)

⇒ Mean = 14092 / 271

⇒ Mean = 52

**The mean of the distribution is 52.**
